scope: Targeted accounting/finance/institutional diffusion and DiD literature, supplemented by live primary-source web searches and local literature corpus; not an exhaustive systematic review.
novelty: No universal absence or first-study claim is established. Prior studies already examine IFRS, ESG and securities-law liquidity. Proposed contribution is common country-level comparisons across the documented wider policy set and a linked diffusion analysis.
